units.source_text: “星星呐……”女人的声音像从漏了的软管里挤出来似的，

en.t: “The stars...” the woman’s voice sounded as if it were being squeezed out through a leaking hose,

units.source_text: “星星，这种时候还不出来，不会有很强烈的大风呀……”

en.t: “If the stars still haven’t come out at a time like this, there won’t be a very strong wind...”
